evidence: Nestled along the banks of the Red River in Gia Lâm District, Hanoi, lies the historic Bát Tràng Pottery Village, a vibrant hub where the ancient craft of ceramics thrives. The heart of this village beats with the fiery presence of ceramic kilns, towering structures that have been the cornerstone of Bát Tràng’s identity since the Ly Dynasty.
